# EMChat Media

> EMChat Media is a privacy-first social network with no ad trackers, no behavioural profiling, and no advertising business model. Founded in 2026 in North Macedonia by Egzon Mehmedi.

EMChat Media (emchat.social) is a consumer social network. It is not related to other products with similar names, such as EMChat AI (a clinical assistant for emergency medicine), Emory Healthcare's emChat, or the emChat online discussion tool used for market research.

EMChat Media (https://emchat.social) lets people share posts and photos, follow a feed built only from the accounts they choose (newest first, nothing else mixed in), message privately (direct messages and group chats), and share a rich profile card. There is no advertising business behind it: no trackers, no data selling, no engagement-ranked feed.

## Key facts

- Name: EMChat Media (also referred to as EMChat)
- Founded: 2026, North Macedonia
- Founder: Egzon Mehmedi
- Pricing: Free to use
- Sign-in: Passwordless (one-time email link, no password)
- Privacy controls: private accounts, per-post visibility, follower approval, block and mute, one-click data export, one-click account deletion
- Photo privacy: uploaded images are re-encoded server-side to strip EXIF and GPS metadata
- Messaging: direct messages and group chats with photos, video and file attachments; message requests keep messages from people you don't follow out of your main inbox until you accept them
- Post visibility: public posts appear only on the author's profile and at their direct link; they are never pushed into other users' feeds
- Source code: https://github.com/emchatsocial/emchat (source-available)

## How EMChat Media differs from ad-funded platforms (Instagram, Facebook, X, TikTok)

EMChat Media's feed is only followed accounts in the order they posted, not ranked to maximize engagement, with nothing else mixed in. See https://emchat.social/transparency for the full explanation. It runs no advertising, so it has no incentive to maximize time-on-app or build behavioural ad-targeting profiles. It is not owned by or affiliated with Meta, X Corp, ByteDance, or any other social media company.
